features.name: Meta pixel
features.description: Loads the merchant's Meta pixel once the visitor consents to marketing, and sends it the shop events.

features.name: Google tags
features.description: Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Tag Manager with the merchant's ids, after consent, with Google Consent Mode v2 and the shop events.

features.name: TikTok pixel
features.description: Loads the merchant's TikTok pixel once the visitor consents to marketing, and sends it the shop events.

features.name: Custom scripts
features.description: Scripts the merchant pastes, added to the page once the visitor consents to their category (analytics or marketing).

features.name: Consent banner
features.description: A cookie banner with the categories necessary, analytics and marketing; the choice stays in the visitor's browser and feeds Google Consent Mode v2.

features.name: Visitor analytics
features.description: Anonymous first-party analytics in the merchant's database: visits, page views, sources, devices and countries; the analytics dashboard widget.

features.name: Conversion funnel
features.description: Records the shop events (view, add to cart, checkout, purchase) and revenue from the page's browser events.

features.name: Searches and 404s
features.description: Records what visitors search for on the site and the pages they reach that do not exist.

features.name: Web Vitals
features.description: Measures how fast and stable pages are for real visitors (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB).

features.name: robots and verification
features.description: The robots.txt rules and the Google, Bing and Meta verification tags, served for the merchant's site to include.

features.name: IndexNow
features.description: Tells search engines about new or changed pages at once, with the merchant's IndexNow key, when the merchant asks (widget or API).

features.name: SEO checklist
features.description: Checks the merchant's pages on request and shows what to fix, with steps.

features.name: Notice bar
features.description: An announcement bar on the website with the merchant's text, a link and the dates it shows.
